report:
## Verdict: APPROVE with notes (three suggestions and two inconclusive checklist items, nothing at or above the critical threshold)

The PR is ready to merge: all eight acceptance criteria verified as met, and no reviewer raised a Critical or Important finding.
Rule applied: rule 6 — only findings below the threshold and INCONCLUSIVE items remain → APPROVE with notes

## Code Review Findings

### 🟡 Suggestion / Minor (3)

<details><summary>3 items</summary>

1. The same model-specific reason ("some models, such as Claude Opus 5.5, reject any temperature") is repeated in five comments: `src/sqllens/config.py:118`, `src/sqllens/agent/core/llm/models.py:36`, `src/sqllens/agent/integrations/anthropic/llm.py:215`, `src/sqllens/agent/core/evaluation/evaluators.py:190` and `src/sqllens/cli.py:606`. All five will become out of date together when model support changes. (raised by 1/6 agents)
2. `LLMAsJudgeEvaluator` in `src/sqllens/agent/core/evaluation/evaluators.py` (lines 178-194) stores its `temperature` without checking it. The 0–2 range is checked only when `evaluate` builds an `LlmRequest`, so an out-of-range value fails on the first evaluation, not when the judge is built. (raised by 1/6 agents)
3. `EffortLevel` is defined twice, in `src/sqllens/config.py` (lines 160-162) and in `src/sqllens/agent/core/llm/models.py`. A unit test keeps the two copies equal; the type system does not. (raised by 1/6 agents)

</details>

### ℹ️ Informational — Deferred

- VC-1: INCONCLUSIVE (important) — The anthropic SDK at the project floor (anthropic>=0.40) and installed version accepts an `extra_body` keyword on both `messages.create` and `messages.stream`, merging `output_config` into the JSON request body. [src/sqllens/agent/integrations/anthropic/llm.py]

  <details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  Installed anthropic 0.125.0 (.prflow/tmp/venv/.../anthropic/resources/messages/messages.py) declares `extra_body: Body | None = None` on sync create (lines 118,412,706,1000), stream (1084/1110) and the async create/stream equivalents (1613..2605). llm.py:218-221 sets payload['extra_body']={'output_config':{'effort':...}}. pyproject.toml:30 has floor anthropic>=0.40,<1. The claim also covers the 0.40 floor, but no 0.40 source is available in the supplied views or venv, so the floor signature cannot be read. Not run: inspecting anthropic 0.40 messages.py (e.g. pip download anthropic==0.40.0). Body-merge behaviour of extra_body was also not traced in _base_client.

  </details>

- VC-2: INCONCLUSIVE (suggestion) — The comment asserts the anthropic>=0.40 floor predates the SDK's `output_config` parameter. [src/sqllens/agent/integrations/anthropic/llm.py]

  <details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  The comment is at src/sqllens/agent/integrations/anthropic/llm.py:218-221, and pyproject.toml:30 pins anthropic>=0.40,<1. The claim needs anthropic 0.40's Messages.create signature, and no 0.40 source is available. The only installed copy is anthropic-0.125.0 (.prflow/tmp/venv/.../anthropic-0.125.0.dist-info), which does not show what 0.40 had. I did not fetch the 0.40 sdist/wheel, so I did not run that check. From memory, 0.40 (about Oct 2024) predates output_config (about late 2025), so the comment is probably true, but that is not evidence I read.

  </details>

acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] With `[llm] temperature` unset, the request payload that `AnthropicLlmService` sends to `messages.create` and to `messages.stream` contains no `temperature` key.
- [ ] With `[llm] temperature = 0.2` (or `SQLLENS_LLM__TEMPERATURE=0.2`), the agent request payload contains `"temperature": 0.2`.
- [ ] With `[llm] effort` unset, the agent request contains no `output_config`.
- [ ] With `[llm] effort = "high"` (or `SQLLENS_LLM__EFFORT=high`), the agent request sends `output_config` equal to `{"effort": "high"}` to Anthropic.
- [ ] Each of exactly these 5 effort values — `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max` — complete by construction, loads without error.
- [ ] An effort value outside that set (for example `SQLLENS_LLM__EFFORT=extreme`) makes `sqllens validate` exit non-zero with a message naming the `effort` field.
- [ ] A `temperature` outside 0–2 (for example `3`) makes `sqllens validate` exit non-zero with a message naming the `temperature` field.
- [ ] The evaluation judge's request carries no `temperature` key when its caller passes none.
